Commentary.Commentary: Keshav Maharaj got a lot of turn and grip from the surface to finish with four wickets. Morkel was outstanding as well and took three wickets along with Rabada. Moeen Ali will be licking his lips at the prospect of bowling here. The home side have James Anderson and Stuart Broad in their ranks who can easily trigger a collapse. With the wicket staying low, things are still in favour of the hosts. Can the Proteas rise to the occasion and make a match out of it? Join us shortly.

A good show with the ball from South Africa has helped them to restrict the lead to 330. They came out this morning and bowled with a lot of aggression to take 7 wickets for 63 runs in the first session. However, the 9th wicket stand of 45 between Bairstow and Wood did a bit of damage to the visitors. It was eventually broken by Rabada who was impressive. The wicketkeeper batsman scored a crucial fifty which could well prove to be the point of difference. The target is still a stiff one on this track and it would need some brilliant batting from South Africa to stay on track.

OUT! Bairstow has been stumped by his counterpart. Tossed up on leg stump. Jonny goes for the slog sweep but misses. He drags his back leg out of the crease in the process. De Kock fails to clip the bails off in the first attempt but does it successfully the second time and appeals. The umpire checks it upstairs. Replays show his foot was out of the crease. Maharaj gets a 4-fer. Bairstow departs just after reaching his fifty. ENGLAND HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 233.
There is a stumping appeal against Jonny Bairstow. He feels that he is a goner.
Very full and down the leg side, Anderson misses the flick and de Kock behind the stumps collects it well.
Guides it down to third man for a run.
15th Test fifty for Jonny Bairstow.
A tad short on middle, Jonny pulls it through mid-wicket for two. He  brings up his fifty with it. A very good knock by him. He has always been a very reliable player for England.
Good length on off, Jonny defends it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length outside off, Bairstow guides it to 2nd slip.
Bowled on leg stump, Bairstow flicks it through square leg but does not take a run.
Slower through the air on leg stump, Bairstow kneels down and paddles it through fine leg for three.
Dean Elgar is calling the fielders inside the circle to stop the single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Loopy ball on off, Bairstow tries to slog sweep it but misses.
Drags his length back a little on off, Bairstow tries to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Tosses it up on off, Bairstow reverse sweeps it straight to point.
Tries to go over the leg side against the spin but gets an inside edge down to short fine leg. Anderson wants a run but Bairstow wants to keep strike.
Bowls it on off stump, Anderson manages to keep it out.
Bangs it in short outside off, Anderson lets it through to the keeper.
Good length outside off, Anderson does not bother playing a shot at it.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Anderson pokes at it but gets beaten.
James Anderson is the last man in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! The bowling change works wonders. Rabada breaks through this partnership. Bowls it a tad short on off, Wood goes for the pull but misses. The ball stays a touch low and hits the top of off. A good innings from Mark Wood, he has scored some useful runs. England lead by 324 runs.
A slip in place now.
Good effort from Morne!  Tad fuller on off, Jonny drives it towards mid off who dives to his right and deflects it to mid on. They run a single.
Kagiso Rabada is back on. Can he break this important partnership?
A tad short outside off, Wood cuts it to point.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Bowled on leg stump, Wood paddle sweeps it through short fine leg for a run.
Gives it some air, Wood comes down the track and plays it inside out over covers for a couple.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Tossed up on off, Wood lifts it over extra cover for a couple.
Length ball on off, stays low a touch. Bairstow defends it off the back foot.
Shorter in length, Mark guides it down to third man for a run.
Bouncer again on middle, Wood pulls it but not from the middle over mid-wicket for a couple.
A tad short outside off, Wood goes for the cut but gets beaten.
FOUR! Bangs it in short aimed at the rib cage of the batsman, Wood tickles it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Good length outside off, Bairstow guides it down to third man for a run. He runs the first one very fast and turns for the second but Wood is quick to shout "NOOOO".
Very full on middle, Mark defends it towards covers.
Drags his length back a little, Wood defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Floats it outside off, Wood kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bowled on middle, skids on with the arm. Wood defends it off the inner half to short leg.
Flatter and outside off, Wood tries to cut but is beaten.
Tosses it on leg stump, Wood defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Well played Jonny. Short on middle, Bairstow upper cuts it over the keeper for a boundary. This is a handy knock from him.
Shorter in length on middle, Bairstow tucks it to square leg.
Full toss on middle, Jonny drives it back to the bowler.
Bowls a well-directed bouncer on off, Wood takes on the pull but gets a top edge towards deep square leg for a run.
Bowled on the pads, Jonny flicks it through square leg for a run. England lead by 300 now.
A tad fuller on off, Bairstow drives it through covers for a couple.
The second new ball is available now. The reviews for both the sides get refreshed as well.
FOUR! Quicker outside off, Wood drives it through cover-point for a boundary. Important runs these for England.
Bowled on middle, skids on with the arm. Wood defends it solidly.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy ball outside off, Wood tries to heave it but misses. That spun a mile.
Flatter on the pads, Wood misses the flick and is struck on the pads.
Tosses it on off, turning away. Wood plays it to backward point. Bairstow wants a run but is sent back by Wood as Bavuma is sharp to attack the ball.
A tad fuller on off, Bairstow drives it to covers.
Length on off, Jonny defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Almost drags it on! A lucky boundary for Jonny. Short and wide outside off, Bairstow tries to cut but gets an inside edge past his off stump and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Lands it on a length on off, Jonny defends it off the front foot.
Full and on the pads, Wood tries to flick but misses and gets hit on his pads. The ball rolls towards fine leg. However, the umpire signals it as a run. May be there was an inside edge.
Angles it into the pads, Bairstow flicks it through the leg side for a run.
A tad shorter outside off, Wood looks to cut but gets beaten.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

In the air... but safe! Tosses it up on off, Wood tries to slog it but gets a top edge and the ball goes high up in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Duminy gives chase and dives full stretch but cannot get a hand to it. Two runs taken.

BIG APPEAL! Bowls an arm ball on middle and leg, Wood tries to defend it off the front foot but misses and is struck on the pads. They all go up in an appeal but the umpire gives it not out. Might be missing leg.
Bowls it outside off, Wood watchfully leaves it.
Tosses it up on off, Bairstow drives it to long off for a run.
Keshav Maharaj will continue from the other end.
Yorker on middle, Wood does well to dig it out.
Bangs it on a length on off, Wood defends it off the back foot.
Just ahead of a length on middle, Wood pushes it back to the bowler.
Lands it on a length on off, Mark defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Angles it into the pads, Wood flicks it down to the fine leg fence. Wood gets off the mark in style.
Starts off on a length on middle, Bairstow plays it with soft hands towards square leg for a run.
We are back for the afternoon session. Jonny Bairstow and Mark Wood to continue their innings. Morne Morkel to bowl first up after lunch. One slip in place. Here we go...
...Day 4, Session 2...

England on the other hand for once have been pegged back in this Test. They have faced a massive collapse on a wicket which is getting very difficult to bat on. Jonny Bairstow who got a reprieve on 7 is fighting it out there but he is losing partners at the other end. England are still ahead in this game with a lead of 279. But with a lot of time in hand anything below 300 can be chased down. Join us for the second session in a while.

What an unbelievable session this has been! The visitors have fought their way back into the game. They gave away 63 runs and bagged 7 wickets. It all started with Morkel bowling an excellent spell at the start of the day where he took 2 wickets. He was well supported by Rabada and Maharaj. South Africa have given themselves a glimpse of hope and they will come out with momentum on their side.
Drifts this one down the leg side, Wood looks to clip it but misses. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 4!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Mark Wood comes out to bat.

OUT! Broad bags a golden duck! This is an excellent phase of play for the Proteas. They have picked up 7 wickets for 43 runs. Before the start of the day's play, England were in the driver's seat but see how the match has completely turned on its head. Tossed up outside off, turns in sharply. Broad goes deep in the crease and goes for the flick but does so straight towards short leg. Theunis de Bruyn stationed there is sharp as a hawk and bends low to his left to grab it. Maharaj picks up his third wicket and he is overjoyed. The ball is gripping a lot on this track and the worries for the batsmen keep on increasing.
A bit short, Jonny hangs back and cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Stuart Broad comes out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Dawson bags a pair. Sharp pace from Rabada and he has caught the batsman completely off guard. He steams in and hurls a full toss in line of the stumps, Dawson is perhaps surprised by it and is late in bringing his bat down. The ball goes past him and knocks the middle stump over. Dawson looks at the umpire and asks him whether it is a waist height no ball. It is referred upstairs. The replays show that the front foot is fine. It also shows that the ball was dipping in on Liam and it is a legal delivery. The youngster has to walk back disappointed. England keep on falling like a pack of cards.
Dawson has been bowled but the umpires are checking for a waist-height no ball.
Full delivery outside off, Dawson doesn't fiddle with it.

That could have sneaked through! Good length delivery on off, tails in substantially. Bairstow looks to defend it tentatively but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls to point. A run taken.
On a length in line of the stumps, turned to the leg side.
Shortish delivery on off, Jonny goes for the pull but is struck on the thigh pad.
Full delivery in line of the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Liam Dawson comes out to bat.

OUT! Vicious turn and Ali gets bamboozled completely! Floated outside off, Ali uses his feet but the ball spins in sharply. He looks to defend it hesitantly but it goes through the big gap between his bat and pad and crashes into the leg stump. That will tell you the story how the wicket is getting more and more difficult to play on. The visitors are ecstatic. They are keeping on chipping away at the wickets. The home side lead by 277 runs.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Great batting from the English wicketkeeper. He is putting pressure on Maharaj. Kneels and sweeps it hard to the deep mid-wicket fence.

FOUR! Bairstow is taking the spinner on. Loopy delivery around off, spinning away. Jonny goes against the spin and drags it over Rabada at mid on. Has played it quite well and the ball races to the fence.
Tossed up outside off, Jonny lets it go.
FOUR! Shot! Floated around off, Bairstow goes inside out over extra cover and does so with ease. Picks up a boundary to his name.
Good length outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Fullish on middle, pushed to mid on.
Full and going down the leg side, left alone.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. One run added to the total.
Full delivery outside off, Bairstow guides it through backward point for a run.
Short delivery on off, pulled to deep square leg for a run.

DROPPED and FOUR! Philander has put down a dolly! Floated around off, Bairstow lofts it over wide mid off but checks his shot a touch. Philander moves to his left from long off, lines it up. However, he hesitates and the ball pops out of his hands and to add insult to injury, it rolls to the fence. He indicates to his teammates that he couldn't sight it properly due to the dark clouds above. That should have been taken, Elgar is not amused at all.
Presses forward to this one and keeps it out.
A bit shorter this time, Bairstow hangs back and pushes it to the off side.
Tossed up delivery, pushed to covers.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. One run added to the total.
Ali comes forward and defends it.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
On a driving length outside off. The English wicketkeeper strokes it to short cover where the fielder stops it.
Short of a length delivery well outside off, Jonny guides it past the point fielder for a couple.
Good length delivery angling in from outside off, keeps a bit low. Bairstow does well to defend it off his back foot.
Fuller in length around off, Ali taps it towards cover-point and sets off. Bavuma is quick to attack the ball to his right but it is a well-judged single.
Full length delivery on off, Moeen strokes it to mid off.
Drifting in with the arm, Jonny defends it beside the pitch on the leg side.
Floated outside off, close to off stump but Bairstow makes a good leave.
Quicker delivery but it is far outside off. Jonny leaves it alone.
Slow through the air on off, spinning away. Bairstow looks to sweep it but is hit on the arm.
Tossed up around off, Ali kneels and sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Floated around off, Ali uses his feet and defends it with his bat and pad close together.
Fullish and width on offer, Moeen goes for a drive but gets it off the outer half behind point. A single taken and he will retain the strike.
Length delivery outside off, eased to extra cover.
On a length on off, Ali with a closed bat face turns it to short mid-wicket.
That's a peach! Rabada runs in from around the wicket and angles it in that off stump channel. It pitches and seams away to beat the outside edge of Ali's hanging bat.
This one angles in substantially from a length into the wicketkeeper batsman. He hops and tucks it around the corner for a single.
Good length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Bairstow points his bat skywards and lets it be.
Full delivery this time, worked to wide mid on for a run.
Quicker delivery outside off, goes straight on. Jonny makes a watchful leave.
Full delivery outside off, Ali kneels and sweeps it all the way along the ground to deep mid-wicket. A run taken and he is off the mark.
Loopy delivery on off, Bairstow kneels and sweeps it through backward square leg for a run.
Floated outside off, Bairstow covers his off stump and allows it through.
Tossed up on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Ali pokes at it but gets beaten. A great over from Rabada.
Welcomes Ali with a bouncer around off, he ducks awkwardly under it.
Moeen Ali is the next man in.

OUT! That is as plumb as you can get! Rabada has struck in his first over of the day. Good length delivery on off, stays low and angles into Stokes. The southpaw hangs deep in the crease and looks to keep it out but misses it to get pinged on the pads. There is a confident appeal in unison from the Proteas and the umpire has no hesitation in ruling it out. Ben Stokes actually walked off before the decision was given. Rabada's teammates encircle him to congratulate him and he puts a finger on his mouth. He has been handed a one-match ban and he signals that he is staying quiet and letting his ball do the talking. South Africa are right back into this contest. England lead by 246 runs.
Length delivery outside off, Jonny dabs it neatly to third man to rotate strike.
Back of a length delivery, shaping in from outside off. Bairstow hops back and defends it beside the pitch on the leg side.
Fuller length delivery on off, the English wicketkeeper pushes it down the track.
Kagiso Rabada comes into the attack for the first time in the day.
This one turns in viciously from one of the rough patches. Stokes hangs deep in the crease to defend it but gets pinged on the thigh pad. The wicket is playing a lot of tricks now.
Spinning in sharply from outside off, Stokes looks to keep it out but is struck on the thigh pad.
A bit short on off, turning away. Bairstow cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.
Floated around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
A touch quicker outside off, spinning away. Jonny watches it closely and lets it go.
Tossed up outside off, turning in. Stokes hangs back and turns it to deep square leg. A run taken. He is off the mark.
A bit fuller this time, angling into Jonny. He covers the line and defends it stoutly. Another tidy over from Morkel and its a maiden.
Length delivery on off, Jonny uses the depth of the crease and keeps it out.
In the channel outside off, holds its line. Bairstow points his bat skywards and allows it through.
Fuller length ball around off, Jonny puts his head down and defends it calmly to short cover.
Beaten! Good length delivery outside off, stays low. Bairstow hangs back to defend but gets completely foxed.
Full length delivery around off, driven off the front foot to mid off.

Time for Drinks. A brilliant first hour of play for South Africa. Morne Morkel has been right on the money and has used that off stump channel to good effect. Both the set batsmen have made their way back to the pavilion and so has Joe Root. England are still a long way ahead of the game but the visitors are showing some fight here.

OUT! Maharaj gets the big fish! The centurion of the first innings fails this time. Lovely stuff from Maharaj, he set him up beautifully. He bowls an arm ball on off, Root tries to punch it through the off side and gets an inside edge and the ball shatters into the stumps. Maharaj is ecstatic. This has been an excellent hour of play for South Africa. They have not let England score freely and also chipped away at the wickets.
Drags his length back a little, Root cuts it straight to point.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Played with the spin to covers.
FOUR! What a response from Root. That ball does not play on his mind. Floats it up outside off, Root goes down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
WOW! That has taken a chunk of the wicket. Tosses it up outside off, the ball turns way too much and is collected by first slip. That was a nasty ball.
Lands it on a length outside off, Bairstow lets it through to the keeper.
Jonny Bairstow is the new man in. Silly mid on in place for him.

OUT! Ballance has to depart! Morkel is on a roll here. He has got his third, second of the day. Length ball on off, straightens after pitching. Gary tries to defend it but gets an outside edge to de Kock who makes no mistake. Morkel has a big smile on his face. A good passage of play for South Africa.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Bowls it on the pads, Root flicks it through square leg for a run.

Almost a chop on! A tad fuller swinging back in. Root tries to drive it but gets an inside edge and the ball just misses the off pole. It goes on the bounce to the keeper who fumbles but no run taken.
Good length on off, Root mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
Root stops Morkel in his delivery stride.
Loopy outside off, Gary defends it off the front foot.
Gives it air, Ballance comes down the track, does not quite get to the pitch of the ball but still goes on with the shot. He flicks it over square leg for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Plays it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Floats it outside off, gets some turn back into the batsman. Ballance tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball lobs down the wicket.
Tosses it up on off, Ballance defends it off the front foot.
Keshav Maharaj comes into the attack.
Bowls it on a length, Root shuffles across and defends it off the front foot.
Lands it on a length outside off, Joe punches it to covers.
A tad fuller on middle, Root drives it to mid on.
Length outside off, Root charges down a little and lets it through to the keeper.
Joe Root strides out to bat.

OUT! Good catch, a very good catch by Bavuma. Morkel gets his second. He gets rid of Cook. A tad fuller outside off, Alastair drives it uppishly towards Bavuma at covers who moves to his right and stretches his hands to take the catch. A stubborn innings by the ex-English skipper comes to an end. South Africa have done well so far this morning. England have taken their lead upto 236.
Good length on off, Ballance guides it down to third man for a run.
A tad shorter on middle, the batsman whips it through square leg for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Lands it on a length on off, Gary defends it towards point.
Good length on off, Gary defends it off the front foot.
Philander is getting some reverse swing here. He shapes it into the batsman on middle, Ballance defends it by getting forward.
Full and swinging into the pads of Cook who flicks it down to fine leg for a run.

EDGED BUT SHORT! Good length outside off, Ballance pokes at it and gets an outside edge but short of Elgar at second slip. The ball hits his leg and rolls to his left. Ballance wants a run but is sent back by Cook.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Wide outside off, invites Ballance to drive. Gary obliges and slashes at it away from the body but gets beaten.
Length ball outside off, Cook drives it off the toe end through backward point for a run.
A touch fuller outside off, Gary leans into it and drives it through covers. Keshav makes good ground to his left and dives and manages to save a run for his team.
Just ahead of a length, Ballance defends it off the front foot.
Bowls it on a length on middle, Cook works it towards short mid-wicket. He wants a run but is sent back by his partner.
Back of a length on off, Cook punches it to covers off the back foot.
Lands it on a length outside off, jags back in a touch. Cook tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Good length on off, Cook gets it off the inner half to short mid-wicket.
A tad fuller swinging in on leg stump, Alastair tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Just ahead of a length, Cook plants his front foot forward and drives it to covers.
Full ball outside off, Ballance slashes at it but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Bangs it on a length, Ballance defends it off the front foot.
BEATEN! Lands it on a length outside off, straightens a touch. Ballance pokes at it but gets beaten.
Length ball on middle, Ballance defends it off the front foot.
A tad fuller outside off, the batsman drives it through covers for a run.
Back of a length on off, Cook guides it to gully.
Length ball on leg stump, stays a touch low. Ballance defends it by getting his bat down in time.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on middle, Cook drives it to the right of mid on. Elgar runs towards the ball, dives  and pushes the ball towards Rabada at mid off who does the mopping up. A run taken.
Good length on middle, Cook defends it off the back foot.
Angles it in on middle, Alastair punches it to mid on.
Fuller length on off, nips back in after pitching. Cook defends it towards mid on.
Length ball outside off, Ballance shoulders his arms to it.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
A tad short outside off, Cook goes for the cut but chops it onto the ground towards point for a run.
Bowls it on a length on off, Cook defends it solidly.
Good length on off, Cook defends it watchfully.
Length on off, Cook prods forward and pushes it to covers. That was well-timed.
Back of a length outside off, Ballance guides it to point.
Lands it on a length on middle, Gary flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length on off, the batsman defends it off the back foot.
A tad fuller outside off, Gary lets it through to the keeper. This one reaches to the keeper on the second bounce.
Length outside off, Ballance does not play a shot at it.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Sprays it on the pads, Ballance helps it away towards the fine leg fence. Morkel makes good ground to his left and dives but is not able to stop the ball.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Short and wide outside off, Cook camps back and cuts it through point and the ball races away to the fence. First boundary of the day for England.
A tad fuller outside off, Cook pushes it to covers.
Good length on off, Alastair defends it off the front foot.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play a shot at it.
Length ball angling across the batsman, Cook does not bother playing at it. The ball is staying really low.
Back of a length on leg stump, Cook flicks it to mid-wicket.
Morne Morkel to bowl from the other end.
OUCH! That really bounced off a length. Ballance comes forward to defend it but is struck on his glove and the ball rolls on the leg side. An eventful first over.
The umpire is cutting a bit of leather that is coming out of the seam.
Wide outside off, Gary shoulders his arms to it.
Angles it into the pads, the batsman flicks it through backward square leg for a run.
And again. A tad fuller outside off, stays very low. Cook lets it through to the keeper who collects it on the bounce.
Length ball outside off, Cook defends it off the back foot.
Straightaway the ball tends to stay low. Length ball which jags back in a little, Ballance flicks it through square leg for a run.

We are ready to get underway. The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Gary Ballance and Alastair Cook will continue their innings. Vernon Philander to start off the proceedings with the ball today. Good news for South Africa, they will be banking on him to provide breakthroughs. Only a slip and gully in place. Here we go...

South Africa on the other hand, would be happy with the fact that Philander will probably be able to bowl today. They would need to chip away at the wickets and stop England from scoring at a brisk rate. A lot will depend on the spinners as they are getting the most assistance out of the wicket. There is a slight chance of showers in the afternoon. Let us hope it does not play spoilsport. We can expect an eventful day of cricket.

Hello and welcome to the 4th day of the 1st Test match between England and South Africa at Lord's. The hosts have dominated so far and they would want to continue that. They would look to bat the visitors out of the game but also give their bowlers enough time to bowl them out. The English side will be aiming to score freely and set a target in the range of 450 to 500.
...Day 4, Session 1...

The ex-English skipper is looking rock solid in the middle and Ballance is playing the perfect foil to him. Morne Morkel has been the only successful bowler till now. Philander didn't bowl today due to a bruise on his bowling hand and that only weakened them. If the Proteas are to make an inspirational fightback, their spinners will have to play a major role. With two days still to go, England will look to bat the visitors out of the game. Join us tomorrow at 1100 local (1000 GMT) to catch all the action. Till then, cheers!

Another day which has gone in favour of the home side. Early in the day, they ensured that South Africa don't get too close to their total and after that, they persisted their way to take the lead to 216. The pitch has gripped and turned but the English batsmen have been equal to the task. The opening pair of Cook and Jennings laid the foundation for their side with a 80-run stand. The tourists tried their best, kept on attacking with aggressive field placements but didn't get the rewards.
Floats it up on off, Cook defends it solidly. STUMPS ON DAY 3.
Bowls it on off, Cook defends it off the front foot.
Slower through the air on leg stump, Ballance tucks it round the corner for a run.
Fires it in on leg stump, Ballance plays it with the angle to short leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tosses it up on off, Ballance defends it off the back foot.
JP Duminy to bowl the last over of the day.
Flatter on off, the batsman plays it to square leg.
Slower through the air outside off, turns sharply into the batsman. Cook does well to guide it past short leg.
Very full outside off, Alastair tries to drives it but misses.
Over the wicket again. Tosses it up outside off, turns back in. Cook works it with the spin on the leg side.
Plays it on the leg side with the spin.
Comes around the wicket. Bowls it quicker on off, Cook plays it off the back foot.
Yorker on the boots, Cook flicks it down through backward square leg for a run.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
A tad short on leg stump, Cook nudges it on the leg side.
Slower one down the leg side, Cook misses the flick and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Good length angling across the batsman who defends it to covers.
Length ball on off stump, Cook defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted ball outside off, Ballance tries to slog sweep it but misses.
Floats it outside off, turns back into the batsman. Gary tries to defend it but it goes off the pad to short leg.
Loopy outside off, Gary goes for the sweep but misses and it hits his back leg.
Maharaj gets some sharp spin back into the batsman. Ballance plays it to short leg.
Tosses it up outside off, turns back in. Ballance defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Keshav Maharaj is back into the attack.
Bowls a high full toss on leg stump, Ballance flicks it towards backward square leg for a run.
Bangs it in short on middle, Ballance does well to evade it.
A tad fuller on middle, Cook flicks it through mid-wicket for a run. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses and the ball hits the batsman instead.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Length ball angling away, stays a touch low. Cook tries to defend it off the back foot but the ball goes under his bat.
Length ball on middle, Cook plays it back to Rabada from the splice of the bat.
A tad short outside off, Cook cuts it through point for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Slower through the air outside off, the batsman shoulders his arms to it.
Very full outside off, Cook drives it to point.
Flatter on middle, Gary flicks it towards square leg for a run.
EASY PEASY! Full toss outside off, Ballance guides it through point for a couple.
Lands it on a length outside off, Cook lets it through to the keeper.
Fullish outside off, Cook drives it to point.
Full on the pads, Alastair flicks it straight to square leg.
Good length on off, Cook defends it off the back foot.
A tad fuller on off, the batsman drives it to mid off.
Full ball on middle, Cook drives it back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery

Was there an edge there? Floats it outside off, Ballance tries to drive it but gets beaten by the sharp away turn out of the rough. First slip dives to his right and takes it. There wasn't any edge eventually.
Tosses it full outside off, Ballance drives it to covers.
FOUR! Well played Gary. Uses his feet well and then lofts the ball over mid on for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Very full on the stumps, Ballance defends it off the front foot.
JP Duminy is back on. 8 overs are remaining in the day.
A tad shorter outside off, Cook tries to cut it but gets a bottom edge and the ball goes on the bounce to second slip.

JUST SHORT! Rabada should consider himself a little unlucky. He bowls a length ball and angles it away from the batsman. Cook pokes at it and gets an outside edge towards Amla at first slip who dives ahead to catch it but the ball falls just in front of him. A good stop in the end though.
Good length outside off, Alastair defends it off the front foot.
A tad short outside off, Cook cuts it to point.
Lands it on a length outside off, the batsman shoulders his arms to it.
FOUR! Angles it on the pads, Cook flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Runs are starting to flow now.
FOUR! Loopy ball outside off, Ballance sweeps it with authority through square leg for a boundary.
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot.
Tosses up outside off, turning back in. Ballance tries to play the reverse sweep but misses and is struck on the body.

Dean Elgar has a chat with Keshav Maharaj. There are some adjustments being made in the field. A slight halt in play. The English batsmen take a bit of a breather. Helmet has been called in for the silly point fielder. A short leg and slip is also in place.
Bowled outside off, turning back in. Cook tries to sweep but gets it off the inner edge towards short fine leg for a run.
Works it with the spin on the leg side.
Full ball outside off, Cook tries to sweep but it hits his pad and lobs to slip.
Bowls it on the pads, Ballance flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
54th Test fifty for Alastair Cook.

LOVELY TIMING! Full ball outside off, Cook just strokes it past wide mid off who gives it chase and pulls it back just before the boundary. Three runs taken. It brings up his fifty. It has been a very patient knock by the ex-skipper. This is his 11111th run in Test cricket.
A tad fuller on off, Cook pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Lands it on a length outside off, Cook just opens his face and guides it through backward point for a boundary.
Good length on off, Alastair defends it off the back foot.
A tad short outside off, Cook cuts it to point.
Flighted outside off, turning in. Gary defends it off the front foot.
Comes down the track and works the ball with the spin to silly mid on.
Floats it on off, Ballance defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball outside off, turning in. Ballance tries to defend it but it hits him on the pads.
Tosses it up outside off, Ballance plays for the turn but it does not. He gets an outside edge past slip.
Bangs it in short, Alastair pulls it uppishly through square leg for a couple. Cook finally scores in 24 balls.
Back of a length outside off, the batsman pushes it to mid off.
Lands it on a length on off, Cook guides it to point.
Almost an edge there. Short of a length ball outside off, Alastair pokes at it but gets beaten.
Good length angling away, Cook defends it solidly.
A tad fuller on middle, Cook defends it out to covers.
Kagiso Rabada is back into the attack as well.
Good news for South Africa. Vernon Philander is back on the field.
Tosses it up on off, Ballance defends it off the front foot.
Dances down the track, tries to flick the ball but gets struck on the pads.
Plays it to mid-wicket with the spin.
Loopy ball outside off, Ballance goes down on one knee and sweeps it hard. The ball hits the short leg fielder's hands and rolls down the pitch. That must have hurt.
Tosses it outside off, turns back into the batsman. Ballance tries to defend it but it pings him on the pads. There is a muted appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Ballance comes down the track, Maharaj drags his length back on off. Gary tries to flick it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, nips away after pitching and also stays a touch low. Cook tries to defend it off the back foot but is beaten.
Good effort by Maharaj! Full and outside off, Gary drives it through extra cover. Maharaj gives it chase, slides and pulls it back before the ball crosses the boundary. He saves a run for his team.
Good length on off, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Too full and outside off, Ballance drives it through point for a boundary. He is off the mark.

GOOD STOP! Lands it on a length angling away from the batsman, Ballance pokes at it and gets an outside edge to gully who dives to his left and makes a good stop. He saved some runs for his team there.
A tad fuller on middle, Ballance pushes it to mid on.
Maharaj lands this one on the rough patch outside off and gets sharp inward spin. Cook goes deep inside the crease to keep it out. He eventually manages to do so.

That was risky! Floated outside off, turning in. Cook goes for a big sweep but is rapped on the pads. There is a huge appeal for an LBW but it is turned down. The ball then brushes Alastair's gloves and rolls past the off stump. The English opener is riding his luck.
Flatter and quicker one, kept out of the back foot.
Fullish delivery well outside off, Alastair shuffles across and defends it tentatively.
Floated outside off, worked around the corner this time.
Cook stays back and turns it to backward square leg.
In the channel outside off, Ballance points his bat skywards to allow it through. A great over from Morkel, bags a wicket-maiden to his name.
Gary Ballance comes out to bat.

OUT! Morkel has provided an important breakthrough. Good consistent bowling from him and he gets rewarded. He bowls this one in the off stump channel and lands it on a back of a length. Gets it to seam away off the deck. Jennings plays at it away from his body and ends up getting a bottom edge. Quinton de Kock behind the stumps moves to his left and takes a regulation catch. The South Africans are elated. The stubborn 80-run opening stand has finally been broken. England lead by 177 runs.
Good length delivery on off, Keaton stays back and pushes it to mid off.
In the channel outside off, left alone again.
Slanting across Keaton. He lets it go.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Jennings chops it to the left of Duminy at gully. He dives to his left to make a good stop.
Floated around off, played with the spin to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Cook presses forward to defend but gets it off the inner half to backward square leg.

Close shave! Turning into Cook sharply from one of the rough patches. He comes forward to counter it but gets an inside edge on the bounce to short leg. It could have easily gone into the hands of the fielder.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Floated outside off, spinning in. Jennings looks to keep it out but is struck on the pads. The ball lobs to the silly mid on fielder. There is excitement among the players but no bat involved.

Three Leg byes! Loopy delivery outside off, Cook puts a big stride forward and goes for the sweep. The ball brushes the thigh pad and goes past de Kock. Bavuma hares after it and shows good football skills to keep the ball in play. Saves a run for his side.
Fuller length delivery slanting across Keaton. He plants his front foot across and allows it through. End of a maiden over.
Good length delivery on off, Keaton hops back and plays it with an angled blade to point.
This one is wider outside off and Jennings doesn't bother to play at it.
Length delivery angling away from Keaton. He doesn't flirt with it.
Fullish on middle and leg, Jennings nudges it towards mid on.
Good length delivery on off, Keaton defends it off the back foot to the off side.
Loopy ball outside off, Alastair goes for a sweep but gets beaten.
Fullish delivery, eased uppishly but on the bounce to silly mid on.
Floated around off, Cook initially kneels to sweep but the length is not there. He adjusts and looks to cut it towards third man but gets beaten.
Loopy delivery outside off, defended off the inner half to mid-wicket.

Vicious turn! That could have shattered the leg stump. Dangerous way to play that. Tossed up outside off, spins down sharply. Cook shuffles across and looks to flick it but misses. Good take by de Kock.
Camps back to the flatter delivery and turns it to mid-wicket.
Good length delivery in the fifth stump channel, Keaton plants his front foot across to allow it through.
Length delivery on off, seams away after pitching. Jennings plays inside the line but gets beaten.
In the channel outside off, Jennings doesn't fiddle with it.

FOUR! Almost a wicket! Similar length delivery on off, seaming away. Jennings pushes at it with hard hands but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies towards Duminy at third slip. He dives full length to his right but the ball just about evades him and rolls to the third man fence.
Fuller length ball on off, Keaton comes forward and defends it to the off side.
Full delivery outside off, Jennings lets it go.
Morne Morkel back into the attack.
Cook nudges this one with the spin to mid-wicket.
Leg bye! Tossed up outside off, Keaton goes for the reverse sweep but the ball brushes his pads and rolls to short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Jennings comes down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Uppish but safe! Slow through the air, Cook goes for the sweep but gets a top edge towards deep square leg. That was risky. Single taken.
Floated outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Fullish delivery, Jennings paddles it towards short fine leg. The fielder moves to his right to stop it. A run taken.
Full in line of the stumps, Cook keeps it out.
Tossed up delivery, Cook eases it to covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery
Quicker one around off, Cook pushes it back to Duminy.
That was a beauty! Slow through the air on middle, Cook prods forward to defend but is foxed by the vicious away turn. De Kock takes the bails off in a flash but no harm done.
Sliding into the pads, worked to mid-wicket.
Streaky! Floated outside off, spinning in sharply. Cook comes down the track and looks to play it straight but skews it off the inner half through mid-wicket. A single taken.
Loopy delivery on off, paddle swept to backward square leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated delivery, Jennings sweeps it uppishly behind square on the leg side. A run taken.
That keeps a bit low. Tossed up around off, spinning in. Jennings camps back and keeps it out.
Jennings once again uses his feet to the tossed up delivery and pads it away.
Drifting into Alastair. He defends it off the inner half down the track. Back-to-back maidens.
Short delivery outside off, Cook goes for the cut but gets a bottom edge on the bounce to the slip fielder.
Slow through the air, pushed to mid off.
Fullish on off, back to the bowler.
Floated on middle, Cook comes forward to defend but gets it off the outer half to covers.
Cook lunges forward in defense to the flighted delivery.
Flatter and quicker one, defended to short leg.
Nicely bowled! Tossed up delivery around off, Jennings presses forward to defend but gets an inside edge past short leg.
Flatter this time, nudged to backward square leg.
Keaton uses his feet and decides to pad the incoming delivery away.
Waits for this one and works it to mid-wicket.
Jennings goes for the fancy reverse sweep but takes it on his pads. The good thing is that Maharaj bowled it a bit outside off.
Another paddle sweep and he has executed it well. Gets it to the same region for a run.
Cute shot! Loopy delivery on middle and leg, Jennings kneels and paddles it to the left side of the fine leg fielder. Two runs taken.
Floated delivery, Keaton lunges forward in defense.
A bit short around off, Cook cuts this one nicely towards Amla at point. He dives to his left and makes a half-stop. A run taken.
Close shave! Tossed up on off, spinning away. Cook rocks back to cut but gets a bottom edge that just rolls past the off stump.
Floated on middle, clipped to mid on.
Fullish delivery on off, eased through mid on for a single.
Quicker one on off, spins in sharply. Cook goes for the slog sweep but gets hit on the shoulder. Intent from him.
Loopy ball around off, worked to the leg side again.
Waits for the flatter delivery and nudges it to short mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery on off, defended to short leg.
Turns this with the spin to the leg side.
Good effort, Morkel! Full toss on middle, Cook plays it through wide mid on. Morkel sprints from mid on and slides near the fence to keep the ball in play. Three runs taken.
Brings out a big stride and defends it with the angle to the leg side.
Cook taps this one to covers with the spin.
Turns this one with the angle to mid-wicket.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Floated outside off, pushed to covers.
Spinning into Keaton. He keeps his bat and pad close together and decides to pad it away. Shouts of catch it but there was no bat on that.
Spinning down sharply, Jennings fails to clip it. De Kock manages to stop it with his pads.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Floated outside off, Jennings with a big stride forward pads it away.
FOUR! Well played! Tossed up around off, Jennings reverse sweeps it behind point and the ball races to the fence. Played that with a lot of composure and executed it to perfection.
That was not far from the leg stump! Flatter delivery, spinning into Jennings. He looks to work it across but is hit on the thigh pad. The ball falls down on the pitch and just rolls past the stumps.
Flighted on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
A bit short outside off, cut to point.
FOUR! Shot! Floated outside off, Cook crunches it through covers for a boundary. The timing was spot on.
Cook pushes the tossed up delivery down the track.
Nice drift towards the pads and fullish in length. Cook looks to play it across but is hit on the pads.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Jennings camps back and keeps it out.
Spinning into the pads, nudged to the leg side.
Jennings uses his feet, looks to clip it away but misses to wear it on the pad. A stifled appeal is turned down. He was a long way down.
That's hit the batsman on his pads.
Good improvisation! Tossed up delivery, Jennings brings out the fancy reverse sweep and gets it through cover-point. Two runs taken.
Floated around off, spinning in. Keaton comes forward and defends it solidly.
Strides forward again and blocks it nicely.
Cook lunges forward in defense to this tossed up delivery.

That was close! Sliding down the leg side, Cook looks to flick it but misses. He overbalances a bit but de Kock fails to collect it. The ball rolls beside him. Alastair thinks that it has gone behind and takes off a run. Eventually he realizes that he needs to get back and does so.
Fullish on middle and off, Cook pushes it to mid on.
Floated outside off, eased through covers for a single.
Tossed up outside off, spinning away. Jennings watches it closely and lets it go.
So spin it is! JP Duminy will bowl from the other end. A slip and a short leg for him. Can he provide the breakthrough?
Will South Africa continue with pace from the other end or will we see some more spin?
Another forward defense with the spin to the short leg fielder. Tidy over from Maharaj.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Cook prods forward and pushes it down the track.
Spinning into Alastair. Defended off the front foot to short leg.
Floated on off, worked to mid-wicket again.
Tossed up delivery, spinning in. Turned past the short leg fielder.
We are back for the final session. The players and the umpires come out in the middle. Alastair Cook to take strike. Keshav Maharaj to continue his spell. A slip and short leg in place. Here we go...
...Day 3, Session 3...

The English openers, Alastair Cook and Keaton Jennings have managed to see the new ball through and have taken the lead to 145 runs. The former had a few nervy moments but has survived. Both the reviews were taken against him but to no avail. The fact that South Africa's go-to man, Philander didn't bowl because of an injury dented them a bit. News is that it is just a bruising on his hand but he is unlikely to bowl today. Rabada has been tidy and Maharaj has got grip and turn. Can the Proteas turn things around in the evening session? Join us in a while to find out.
Good length on middle, Keaton defends it solidly. THAT IS TEA ON DAY 3.
Strays down the leg side, Jennings lets it through to the keeper.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Full on the pads, Jennings flicks it past the diving square leg fielder for a boundary.
News is coming in that Vernon Philander doesn't have any fracture on his right hand. There is a bit of bruising. He will likely come back tomorrow and take the field.
Sprays down the leg side, Jennings misses the flick and it goes through to the keeper.
Full on middle, Jennings drives it past mid on. There are two fielders after the ball. Kuhn chases after it from mid off and dives to stop it. The batsman run two.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Plays it with the spin on the leg side.
Tosses it up on off, turns into Cook who defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good stop by Elgar. Floats it up on off, Jennings reverse sweeps it towards first slip. Elgar manages to get a hand to it and the ball rolls towards third man for a run.
LOVELY TIMING! Loopy ball on middle, Cook works it with the spin through wide mid on for three.
Back of a length on off, Jennings defends it solidly. Maiden from Rabada. He is keeping things tight here.
Bowls it on a back of a length outside off, Jennings does not bother to play at it.
Good length outside off, Keaton shoulders his arms to it.
Fulla and outside off, Jennings drives it towards covers.
Good length ball angling into the pads, Keaton pushes it to mid on.
Lands it on a length outside off, Jennings lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Very full ball outside off, Cook drives it through covers for a boundary. South Africa are in desperate need of a wicket here.
Plays it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Flighted on off, Cook sweeps it to backward square leg.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Floats it outside off, Cook tries to sweep but misses and is struck on the pads. The ball lobs towards point.
Tosses it up on off, Cook works it with the spin on the leg side.
Fullish length outside off, Jennings gets it off the outside edge and on the bounce to backward point.
Back of a length on off, Keaton defends it off the back foot.
Good length outside off, Jennings lets it through to the keeper.
Full outside off, the batsman drives it towards covers where Morris the substitute dives to his left and makes a good stop.
Very full on off, Jennings digs it out to covers.
A tad fuller outside off, Jennings lets it through to the keeper.
Kagiso Rabada is back on.
Loopy ball outside off, Cook defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter on off, does not turn that much. Jennings adjusts and steers it past slip for a single.
INNOVATION! Maharaj bowls it full outside off, Jennings plays the reverse sweep but straight to backward point.
Tosses it on off, Keaton pushes it to covers.
Floats it outside off, turns back into the batsman. Keaton defends it off the front foot.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, Alastair eases it past the bowler. The mid on fielder runs to his right and denies a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Third slip in place for Morne Morkel.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! A bit fuller outside off, Cook plays at it with soft hands and gets it wide of second slip. No protection in the deep and the ball whistles away to the ropes.

FOUR! A bit streaky but he will take it. Good length delivery slanting across Cook. He pushes at it but gets it off the outer half. The ball flies between second slip and gully and goes through to the fence.

Fractionally overpitched outside off, Keaton leans into it and strokes it through covers. The ball is going down the slope but Kuhn sprints after it. Slides near the fence to keep the ball in play. Saves a run for his side.
Short of a length delivery angling away from Jennings. He points his bat skywards to allow it through.
FOUR! Loopy ball outside off, Cook drives it through covers against the spin for a boundary.
Plays it on the on side with the spin.

NOT OUT! South Africa have lost both their reviews. This one was much closer to the last one. Looked close to the naked eye. Maharaj floats it up outside off, Cook tries to cut but is beaten by the sharp turn into him and the ball raps him on the pads. There is a loud appeal but the umpire shakes his head. After a long chat between the South Africans, they finally decide to review. The umpire refers it upstairs. The replays show the front foot is fine. There is no bat on it. It pitches outside off but the impact is outside off. On-field call stays. Cook survives.
Dean Elgar has opted to take a review against Alastair Cook. Looks close to the naked eye but the impact seems to be outside off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Full toss on middle, Cook sweeps it through square leg. Amla makes good ground to his left and dives but is unable to stop it.
Almost an edge there! Tosses it up outside off, goes straight with the arm. Cook tries to drive it but gets beaten.
Time for spin. Keshav Maharaj is introduced into the attack.
Bangs it on middle, Jennings defends it off the back foot.
A touch fuller on off, Keaton drives it to mid off.
Full and wide outside off, Jennings does not bother playing a shot at it.
Lands it on a length on off, Jennings defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Bouncer on leg stump, Keaton ducks under it.
Bangs it in short outside off, the ball bounces way above the batsman's head who ducks under it.
A tad fuller outside off, Cook guides it to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length on off, Cook defends it off the back foot.
JAFFA! Length ball on off, Cook pokes at it but gets beaten.
Angles it into the pads, Cook flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Cook guides it down to third man for a boundary.
Bowled it on a length on middle, Keaton defends it off the back foot.
Full and wide outside off, Jennings leaves it alone.
Length ball outside off, the batsman lets it through to the keeper.
Lands it on a length outside off, Keaton shoulders his arms to it.
Full ball on off, Jennings drives it to short cover.
Good length outside off, Keaton does not bother playing a shot at it.
Length outside off, Cook lets it through to the keeper.
LOVELY BOWLING! Full ball, angling away from the batsman. Cook tries to drive it but gets beaten.
Short and wide outside off, Cook is beaten on the cut.
Bowls a fast ball on a length on leg stump, jags back in a little and pings Cook on the thigh pad.
Bowls it on a back of a length on off, Cook defends it onto the ground.
Length ball outside off, Cook shoulders his arms to it.
Driven towards the mid off region.
Angles it into the pads, Cook flicks it to fine leg for a run. 1000 Test runs for Cook against South Africa.
Wide down the leg side, no trouble at all for the batsman.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Good length outside off, Cook lets it through to the keeper.

NOT OUT! South Africa waste a review. Back of a length on leg stump, Cook shuffles across and tries to defend it off the back foot but misses and is struck on the pads. They all go up in an appeal but the umpire gives it not out. Elgar after a chat with his teammates decides to review. It is taken upstairs. Replays show that the front foot was fine. There was no inside edge but the ball has pitched outside leg. The on-field call stays. Cook survives.
A review has been taken for an LBW against Cook. Looks to have pitched outside leg.
Back of a length on middle, Jennings defends it off the back foot.
Full on middle, Keaton drives it to mid on.
NO BALL! Length ball outside off, Jennings does not bother playing a shot at it. Rabada has overstepped on this occasion.
FOUR! A tad fuller on middle, Jennings flicks it through mid-wicket for boundary. This also takes the lead above 100 for England.
Bangs it in short, Jennings ducks under it. He holds his pose for a while.
Drifts it on the pads, Keaton tries to flick but misses and is rapped on the pads.
Good length ball, shaping in a touch. Jennings tries to work it on the leg side but misses and is struck on the pads.
Fuller length outside off, Cook lets it through to the keeper.
Lands it on a length on off, Cook is squared up a bit but manages to defend it to the off side. Tight lines here from South Africa.
A tad fuller on off, Cook defends it off the front foot.
Fuller length ball on off, Cook defends it solidly.
A tad fuller on the pads, Cook flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Sprays it down the leg side, Cook misses the flick.
Length ball angling across the batsman who shoulders his arms to it.
Bowls it wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Lands it on a length, Jennings defends it by covering the line of the ball.
A tad shorter on off, Jennings plays it with an angled bat to gully. A bit uppish but safe!
Back of a length on middle, Jennings defends it off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, Keaton lets it through to the keeper.
Kagiso Rabada to bowl from the other end.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

Bowls it on a length on off, Jennings plays it with soft hands towards covers and runs for a single. Kuhn picks up the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Had he hit, Keaton might have been a goner.
Lands it on a length outside off, Keaton plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Good length on off, Cook taps it to covers and takes off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
A touch short on middle, Cook flicks it to mid-wicket.
Vernon Philander is going for an X-ray. He took a few blows to his hand while batting. Hope it is nothing serious.
Starts off on a length on middle, Cook defends it off the back foot.
